app Ordered
use Provider {take as alias}
Given
 contract Box { left:text,right:text }
When
 scenario echo(value:Box) read=true -> bool by=members
  do return true
  examples
   value -> starts_with(prefix=value.left,value=value.right),alias(b=value.right,a=value.left)
   {left="A",right="AB"} -> true,"A|AB"
Then
package Provider
 Given
  export derive take(a:text="D",b:text=a):text = format("{a}|{b}",{a=a,b=b})
 When
 Then
